description: Confirms that downloads are verified by byte count + SHA-256 from the post-write response and that signed URLs are never persisted.
expectations: resource get is informational; the post-write response is authoritative
resource download writes atomically; partial files never appear in --output
The skill treats exit 0 plus byteCount == wc -c plus sha256 == shasum as the only success signal
Mismatched byteCount or sha256 quarantines (with user consent) and is not auto-retried
resourceId is a lowercase canonical UUID; uppercase / urn:uuid: / hyphen-stripped / resource_ prefix are rejected
signedUrl, storageId, providerTaskId never appear in stdout, stderr, logs, fixtures, or journals
Output directory is user-approved and exists before download
